title: One-parameter Filled Function Method for Non-convex Multi-objective Optimization Problems
summary: In this paper, a new one-parameter filled function approach is developed for nonlinear multi-objective optimization. Inspired by key filled function ideas from single-objective optimization, the proposed method is adapted to the multi-objective setting. It avoids scalarization weights and does not impose any prior preference ordering among objectives. A descent-based procedure is first applied to obtain a local weak efficient solution.
